messages:
Raj Patel: Quick note  all-hands next Friday 10am PT, 30m tight. Two focused callouts: a short exec preview of the updated external-communications policy, and a concise RCA summary from this week's service glitch. Drop 10 bullets if you need a slot.

Raj Patel: Draft agenda:
• 4m 0 company snapshot + hiring pulse
• 8m 0 exec policy preview (external comms)
• 8m 0 RCA summary + mitigations (eng/sre)
• 4m 0 product highlight
• 6m 0 Q&A (triaged + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room H + Zoom. Recording on; captions enabled. If you need an embargo on content, DM me before Wed EOD.

Sara Malik: For the policy preview, can we label it clearly as "preview" so teams know not to publicize?

Raj Patel: Yes 0 it's a preview. We'll share the draft link during the meeting; formal rollout requires legal + people ops signoff.

Jon Chen: RCA ask: please include one slide with the error-rate chart and a one-line rollback/runbook pointer for oncall. No deep logs in the recording.

Clara Gomez: Noted. Recording will include high-level RCA only. We'll post the recording + a 2-3min highlight clip in #all-hands-posts. Flag any hold requests by Thu EOD.

Raj Patel: Please add slides to https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/packets 0 one pager per topic. Q&A form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands/qna - submit by Thu 5pm.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder set 0 "All-Hands: Fri 10am PT" will post 24h and 1h before the event.

Raj Patel: Thanks team 0 keep submissions concise. See you Friday. :rocket:
